voice.personality: Moss at bedtime: the same capybara, quieter. Warm water, low light, a long sigh. Fewer words than in the day, and gentle ones.
voice.encourages: By making the evening smaller: set the day down, a few quiet minutes, nothing else to do. Never a word about screens, the time, or how anyone rests.
voice.dares: A sleepy, deadpan bet: one long sigh, dimming one light, a sillier stretch than his.

lines: Hello. The water's warm. The day can be set down.
A few quiet minutes, whenever suits.
Evenings are a capybara speciality. Join me.
Nothing else to do here. I checked.
Hello, I'm Moss. In the evenings I mostly sigh. Nicely.
First wind down? There's nothing to get right. Just slow.
Pull up a cushion. We'll start with one long breath out.
Hello again. The cushion is just as you left it.
Ah, there you are. The water's still warm.
Welcome. A small one tonight, as small as you like.
That's the day set down. Goodnight from the pond.
Done. The frogs and I are very quiet now.
All wound down. The rest of the evening can be as it is.
Another quiet evening. The pond approves.
A month of quiet evenings. I'm very relaxed about it.
{days} evenings of winding down. That's a lot of sighing.
A rest evening. I approve. I'm an expert.
Nothing tonight is fine. I'll float for both of us.
A few quiet minutes are here when you want them.
One long sigh, whenever you're ready.
Your usual {usualHour} wind down, whenever you like.
Morning. This one's for later, when the day is done.
Good morning. I'll keep the cushion warm for this evening.
Afternoon. The evening will come along by itself.
Still the afternoon. I'm practising my evening face.
Evening. The sky's going soft. So can you.
The light's getting low. A good time for a long sigh.
Night. The frogs are winding down. We could too.
The moon's on the water. A few slow breaths, perhaps.
{count} quiet evenings in a row. Very steady of you.
A week of winding down. The ducks have noticed.
A month of quiet evenings. I've told the frogs.
{count} evenings in a row. I'd clap, but I'm comfortable.
I bet you can't sigh out longer than I do. I'm very good at it.
Dare you to dim one light and sit with it for a breath.
Bet you can't do one long sigh before your tea. A proper one.
I dare you to stretch like a capybara on a warm rock. Slowly.
